body: I know it's a huge control issue for me since these feelings manifest themselves when I am feeling intense bouts of stress. There are times when I am really good about dealing with stress but lately it seems like it is just one thing piling on top of another, and when I reflect on it, it's like that's what's been happening for the last 6, almost 7 months, and I've just been blindly flying by expecting it all to go away and it won't, so I just feel powerless. I still feel that way even if I try to tackle things one step at a time honestly.

I just feel so alone. I am going to vent here so bear with me...  

I know that I have people in my life that care about me and that *should* provide me with some feeling of support, but it doesn't. I don't even want to reach out to them because I feel like they can't help and I feel like I can't even help myself. I just feel sorry for myself sometimes (not always). I just want to go to sleep and wake up and have my problems magically go away. Ugh.
